text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
—Everyone, take a look! 
Tokyo Racecourse is bustling with 
unprecedented excitement today!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The energy here is virtually 
indistinguishable 
from how it was before crowd restrictions 
were put in place! 
And taking place amidst this incredible 
atmosphere is—

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The Japan Cup, bringing together the 
finest lineup 
from both home and abroad!

text_block_list.name: Phone Audio
text_block_list.text:
"With this year's most talked-about 
classic contenders 
having declared their entry, who will 
emerge 
as the ultimate victor today?!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
This is... Ohiruma Talks, isn't it? 
Oh, I used to watch this all the time back 
home...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
They're doing a live broadcast here right 
now. 
...Wait, why are we watching this show?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Looking at the TV guide earlier, it 
mentioned live interviews with 
fans on-site. If that was the case, there 
would undoubtedly 
be plenty of reactions regarding Daring 
Tact.
choice_data_list:
(I hope this gives Daring Tact 
strength...!)

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
And now, let's head straight into some fan 
interviews... 
Oh, those folks over there! 
Excuse me! Do you have a quick moment to 
chat?!

text_block_list.name: Local Residents
text_block_list.text:
"Oh... yes!" "Whoa, that mic... 
Could it be Ohiruma Talks?!" 
"No way, we watch you all the time~!"

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Viewers of the show! Thank you so much! 
Now straight to the point: who's your 
favorite pick today?!

text_block_list.name: Local Residents
text_block_list.text:
Daring Tact, 
of course!

text_block_list.name: Local Residents
text_block_list.text:
"Daring Tact, we finally made it here!" 
"Look, matching happi coats!" "Give it 
your all!" 
"We'll make sure our voices reach you!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
My pick? As in my favorite? 
Then Daring Tact, hands down!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Daring Tact! Are you watching? 
—Do your best, we know you can do it!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
—Daring Tact and Efforia! 
I came out here to cheer on both of them!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Seeing both of them run with absolute 
faith in themselves. 
That's my one true wish!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Actually... today is the very first time 
I get to see Daring Tact race in person! 
Until now, I've always watched from home.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
So my favorite pick is Daring Tact, no 
question! 
Thank you for giving us hope during those 
tough times!

text_block_list.name: Phone Audio
text_block_list.text:
"—We're here to cheer on Daring Tact 
today! 
I came together with friends I met through 
social media! 
Go get 'em, Daring Tact!"

text_block_list.name: Phone Audio
text_block_list.text:
"—Her Triple Tiara was moving enough, but 
seeing her 
never give up and fight her way back gave 
me so much strength."

text_block_list.name: Phone Audio
text_block_list.text:
"The first race I ever watched crowned a 
Triple Tiara 
winner... It's burned into my memory. 
You'll always be my number one—Daring 
Tact!"

text_block_list.name: Phone Audio
text_block_list.text:
"—Thank you, Daring Tact!" 
"—Thank you so much!!" 
"—Thank you for running for us!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: What am I supposed to do, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I'm the one who wants to give back to 
them. 
Receiving this much love...
choice_data_list: You deserve to take every bit of it.
You deserve to take every bit of it.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.
choice_data_list: Embrace it—and repay them with victory.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text:
Daring Tact, even when facing such a cruel 
fate... 
you remain strong. I want to know... why.

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text:
You've got more in you... don't you, 
Daring Tact? 
Surpass your greatest self.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: (—A harsh wind is blowing.)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
(To me, this must surely feel like a 
blizzard. 
Blinding my sight, 
leaving me unable to tell where to go.)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
(And yet, I don't feel cold in the 
slightest. 
Because my heart is lit with so much 
love.)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: (I know the path forward, too. Because—)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
All this time... 
your simple, unadorned trust 
has been pushing me forward from behind.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
That is why I know which way to go. 
Wherever your warm hands push me... is my 
path.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: You were my guiding light all along.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I've taken your feelings into my heart as 
well, Trainer. 
I will turn all of it into strength.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I will never, ever give up— 
not until the very last stride—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I'll show everyone a Daring Tact 
who goes even further than the one 
they've always loved!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Here I go!
